newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises more than 100 points in afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises more than 100 points in afternoon trade.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rose more than 100 points Thursday after a report of weak retail sales in May sparked a rally in the bond market.

Just after 2:35 p.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue-chip issues was up 109.66 points at 7,685.49. The benchmark 30-year Treasury rose nearly a point, sending its yield down to 6.77 percent from 6.84 percent on Wednesday.
